_documentation.purpose: Task config for the Migration Shape-Spec Batch Generation flow. Persona is product-manager; the task consumes a saved GeneratedMigrationBookOfWork (Spec 1 output) + saved WorkItems + focused migration context per story and emits literal `/agent-os:shape-spec [spec details]` implementation specs in configurable batches (default 25). Generation is gateway-orchestrated; AMS owns persistence + the focused-context endpoint only. Implementation-Ready enrichment (2026-06-14): the Generated variant's `tests` is now a STRUCTURED array of {title, description, type: unit|functional} (D6) and a new `coveredEndpointIds: string[]` field captures the model EndpointEntity UUIDs in scope (D9; empty for non-endpoint stories), so the gateway can hydrate the Implement screen as a completed PM -> TE session.
_documentation.contextNeeds: book-of-work (saved GeneratedMigrationBookOfWork), saved-work-items (saved story WorkItems from the book of work), migration-spec-context (NEW focused per-story resolver introduced by this spec - A-5), api-baselines, architecture-mappings, discovery-findings, target-state-decisions-context (Spec 2026-05-25 PM Tasks Captured Decisions Integration -- captured decisions are evidence the generated spec must cite via evidenceRefs[]), target-tech-stack-context (Spec 2026-05-25 Tech-Stack.md Pre-fill + Target-Tech-Stack.md Write -- rendered target tech stack the implementation guidance must honour).
_documentation.responseSchema: Three-variant structured response (Generated / InsufficientContext / Failed) validated by gateway/src/services/specGenerationResponseValidator.ts (hand-rolled, no schema library - A-4).
_documentation.promptRules: Output MUST be the literal `/agent-os:shape-spec [spec details]`; never fabricate missing contracts/mappings/data/architecture details (return status='insufficient_context' instead); cite the provided focused-context + evidence references; preserve functional like-for-like; keep each spec scoped to its story. Implementation-ready: emit scope-in/out + testable acceptance criteria + a structured unit/functional test pack ({title, description, type}); resolve ambiguity via documented assumptions, NOT open questions.
_documentation.designPointRefs: R-2 gateway-only orchestration; R-3 sync per batch; R-4 serial within batch; R-7 confidence downgrade; R-8 re-run idempotency; R-11 auth gating verbatim from product-manager--migration-delivery-plan (Spec 1); R-12 per-story failure isolation; R-13 / A-7 LLM-output fixtures; A-4 hand-rolled validator; A-5 new focused-context resolver; A-6 lazy not_attempted.

description: Consumes a saved migration book of work + its saved WorkItems and produces literal `/agent-os:shape-spec [spec details]` implementation specs in configurable batches (default 25). Each generated spec is implementation-ready and linked to its saved WorkItem with per-story status (generated | generated_with_warnings | insufficient_context | failed | skipped_blocked), confidence (high|medium|low), warnings, missingInputs, evidenceRefs, a structured unit/functional test pack, coveredEndpointIds, and predicted-vs-actual readiness comparison preserved. Generation is gateway-orchestrated (R-2); AMS owns persistence + the focused-context endpoint only. No fabrication: stories without sufficient focused-context return status='insufficient_context' rather than a faked spec body.

responseFormat.description: Three structured-response variants validated by assertSpecGenerationResponse (gateway/src/services/specGenerationResponseValidator.ts). Branch is keyed on the top-level `status` field.

Generated.description: status='generated' or status='generated_with_warnings'. Required: confidence, specText (MUST start with literal `/agent-os:shape-spec`), warnings, evidenceRefs, assumptions, tests (structured {title, description, type: unit|functional} array), affectedAreas, coveredEndpointIds (model EndpointEntity UUIDs in scope; empty for non-endpoint stories).

specText.description: MUST begin with the literal string `/agent-os:shape-spec` and MUST reference the target story / WorkItem title or scope. Implementation-ready: the body carries Feature summary + Scope in / Scope out + testable Acceptance criteria + an inline unit/functional Test Pack. Validator enforces an actionability heuristic (non-empty affectedAreas OR non-empty tests OR specText length above a content-length floor).

assumptions.description: Falsifiable assumptions recorded in lieu of open questions; the spec must stand alone (no follow-up conversation).

tests.description: Structured unit/functional test pack (D6). Each acceptance criterion maps to >= 1 test. NO integration / E2E (those are Spec 2).

coveredEndpointIds.description: Model EndpointEntity UUIDs this story migrates (D9). MAY be empty for non-endpoint stories (DB schema / data migration / other-service / infra). Forward-only groundwork; never fabricate ids.

InsufficientContext.description: status='insufficient_context'. Required: missingInputs (non-empty), reason, recommendedNextAction, evidenceRefs.

artifacts.description: Per-story shape-spec generation results (status / confidence / warnings / missingInputs / evidenceRefs / generated spec text / structured test pack / coveredEndpointIds) for the configured batch. Persisted to architecture-model-service via POST /api/projects/{projectId}/migration-books-of-work/{bookId}/spec-generations/batch (R-1, R-12). The gateway is the sole orchestrator (R-2); there is NO AMS-side generation endpoint.
